references.text: Repeats the mention of the conquered area from Mount Halak to Baal-Gad and lists the kings that Joshua and the Israelites defeated.
Mentions Baal-Gad at the foot of Mount Hermon as a geographical boundary marker for the unconquered land.
Summarizes Joshua's conquests and how he struck down all the kings, in the same manner described in this verse.
Refers to Mount Hermon and Baal-Gad as part of the conquered area under Moses and Joshua.
Describes the same geographical area at Mount Hermon that the Israelites took possession of.
Mentions Mount Hermon and the Valley of Mizpah (the Lebanon valley) in connection with the kings who gathered against Israel.
Describes the northern boundary of the land toward Mount Hor and Lebo-Hamath, near the Hermon region.
